_comment: Transcribed from in-game screenshots taken 2026-08-04 (Steam capture 20260804154439 (art), 154722 (loadout)). The page leads with the in-game class name, which is the title the loadout screen shows; the model designation rides underneath. One page covers both faction variants; both models were captured, NATO on 2026-08-04 15:43-15:48 and Pax Armata at 16:59-17:00. TBD is deliberate everywhere: a slot screen names every option in its row but describes only the highlighted one, so most options are named and not yet described.
name: Transport Helicopter
_variant_note: Both factions field the same model here; only the livery differs, so the two captures show one vehicle in NATO and Pax Armata colors.
